meta.title: Trucker: road freight across the Gulf
meta.description: Trucker is a planned road freight platform for shippers, carriers, vehicle owners and drivers, in English, Arabic and Urdu.

environment.development: Development build. Not a live service. All content is sample content.

hero.title: Road freight across the Gulf, one signed step at a time
hero.lead: Shipper, carrier and driver work from the same record, from pick-up to proof of delivery. In English, Arabic and Urdu.

example.title: Dubai to Riyadh
example.label: Illustration
example.note: The shipper, the carrier and operations read this same list. Each step shows who signed it and when.

items.title: Post the load
items.text: Describe the goods, the sites and the time windows once.

items.title: Compare offers and book
items.text: Verified carriers quote. You accept one, with the price and terms fixed.

items.title: Follow each signed step
items.text: The driver signs every milestone, even without signal.

items.title: Confirm proof of delivery
items.text: Photos and the receiver's signature close the job.

items.title: Shippers
items.text: Describe a load once, compare offers on the same terms and follow every step to delivery.

items.title: Carriers
items.text: See loads that fit your fleet and the routes you are permitted to run. Assign truck, trailer and driver.

items.title: Drivers and vehicle owners
items.text: One clear next step at every stop. Steps are saved on the phone when there is no signal.

languages.title: The same sign in three languages
languages.lead: Every screen is designed in English, Arabic and Urdu. Arabic and Urdu read right to left; numbers, plates and references stay left to right.

footer.note: Draft copy. The service described is planned, not live. Launch countries and routes are not decided.
